description.value:
You don't out-muscle the wasteland's monsters. You out-think them, and leave before they notice you were there.

SIGNATURE — your Marked quarry takes a penalty to notice or react to you and your Feral Bond specifically.

cinderfall.incomplete: Ranger's Outwit classfeature (P4) is the exact real analog (FlatModifier AC/skill bonuses vs. target:mark:/origin:mark:) — buildable once the Mark exists and this card states an actual number. The Waywarden's central subsystem, The Mark (classes.waywarden.json flags.cinderfall.terms[0]: "designate a creature as your quarry, gaining a growing bonus to track, target, and punish it specifically"), has zero Foundry-schema footprint anywhere in the corpus. classes.waywarden.json:65 itself carries "rules": []. No card anywhere grants a TokenMark effect (site/data/cards/abilities/, class-features/, feat-effects/ are all empty scaffold directories -- confirmed via ls, contents are .gitkeep only). Real pf2e's own equivalent mechanic (Ranger's Hunt Prey) is fully buildable and precedented, but that infrastructure (an action item + a TokenMark-carrying effect item) does not exist for Waywarden and is not one of the 56 files in scope for this draft. This card is blocked until a future pass authors the base Mark action/effect.
